0022600203.text: The Lakers (9-2, first in the Pacific and the West) come in on a five-game winning streak and a 4-1 road record, while the Hawks (7-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East) have won four straight. Luka Doncic is out with back soreness and Quentin Grimes is day-to-day with a finger injury and a game-time decision for the Lakers, while Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Lakers won the most recent meeting 141-116 in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
